description: This file defines a Go package 'procfs' that reads and parses the /proc/net/unix file to extract Unix socket information, including socket type, state, flags, inode, and path.

classes.name: NetUNIXLine
classes.description: Represents a line of /proc/net/unix with socket details such as kernel pointer, reference count, protocol, flags, type, state, inode, and path.

classes.name: NetUNIX
classes.description: Holds a collection of NetUNIXLine entries representing all Unix sockets read from /proc/net/unix.

methods.name: FS.NetUNIX
methods.description: Public method to retrieve Unix socket data from /proc/net/unix.

methods.name: readNetUNIX
methods.description: Reads and parses the /proc/net/unix file, returning a NetUNIX structure.

methods.name: parseNetUNIX
methods.description: Parses the stream of /proc/net/unix data into a NetUNIX structure.

methods.name: NetUNIX.parseLine
methods.description: Parses a single line of /proc/net/unix into a NetUNIXLine object.

methods.name: NetUNIX.parseUsers
methods.description: Parses the user count from a string.

methods.name: NetUNIX.parseType
methods.description: Parses the socket type from a string.

methods.name: NetUNIX.parseFlags
methods.description: Parses the flags from a string.

methods.name: NetUNIX.parseState
methods.description: Parses the socket state from a string.

methods.name: NetUNIX.parseInode
methods.description: Parses the inode number from a string.
